decisions.reason: The fouling detection automation was launched only in 2023 and is part of the visible fouling-monitoring direction the firm has invested in, so management will put early weak results down to market ramp-up and persist with it.

The weir dimensioning web tool costs little to maintain and serves customers who buy the core equipment, so although it is less central than the fouling line, management sees little reason to pull it so soon after a public launch.

The fouling detection system is the firm's main new hardware investment and is publicly tied to its announced direction in heat exchanger monitoring, so sunk costs and the need to justify the decision make continuation very likely.
